question: studies with over 50,000 participants
cypher:
match(s:study)-[]-(p:participant) 
with s, count(p) as part_count
where part_count >= 50000
return s.study_name, s.study_short_name as study_short_name, part_count as number_of_participants

question: studies that started after the year 1990
cypher: MATCH (s:study) where s.enrollment_beginning_year >= 1990 return s.study_name, s.study_short_name

question: studies that started after the year 2000
cypher: MATCH (s:study) where s.enrollment_beginning_year >= 2000 return s.study_name, s.study_short_name

question: studies that are still active
cypher: match(s:study) where lower(s.study_status) = "active" return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, s.study_beginning_year, s.study_ending_year

question: group studies by total participants
cypher:
match(s:study)-[]-(p:participant) 
return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, count(p) as number_of_participants

question: show studies that lasted 10 years or more
cypher: match(s:study) where ((case s.study_ending_year when 'On Going' then 2025 else toInteger(s.study_ending_year) end)  - toInteger(s.study_beginning_year)) >= 15 return  s.study_name, s.study_short_name, s.study_beginning_year, s.study_ending_year

question: How many male participants in all studies.
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where tolower(p.participant_sex) = "male" return count(p) as total_male_participants

question: how many females, grouped by study
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where tolower(p.participant_sex) = "female" return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, count(p) as total_female_participants

question: how many females in each study
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where tolower(p.participant_sex) = "female" return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, count(p) as total_female_participants

question: how many white males in the PLCO study?
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) where tolower(p.participant_sex) = 'male'   and tolower(p.participant_race) = 'white' return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.participant_sex, p.participant_race, count(p) as total_white_male_participants

question: list of all study names
cypher: match(s:study) return s.study_name, s.study_short_name

question: how many participants have breast cancer?
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where lower(p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site) contains("breast") return count(p) as total_participants_with_breast_cancer

question: how many participants have breast cancer by study
cypher: match (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where lower(p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site) contains("breast") return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, count(p) as total_participants_with_breast_cancer

question: All Cancer Types in the PLCO Study, by sex and race
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) where p.participant_case_indicator = 'Yes' return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site as cancer_diagnosis_primary_site, p.participant_sex, p.participant_race, count(p) as participants_with_cancer

question: All Cancer Types in the PLCO Study, by sex and race, show top 10 counts
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) where p.participant_case_indicator = 'Yes' return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site as cancer_diagnosis_primary_site, p.participant_sex, p.participant_race, count(p) as participants_with_cancer ORDER BY participants_with_cancer DESC LIMIT 10

question: how many cancer types in the PLCO study?
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) WHERE p.participant_case_indicator = 'Yes' RETURN s.study_short_name,  COUNT(DISTINCT p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site) AS Cancer_Types

question: what unique cancers were collected in the SMCT study?
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) WHERE p.participant_case_indicator = 'Yes' RETURN Distinct s.study_short_name,  p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site AS Cancer_Types, count(p) as Numer_Of_Participants

question: sex and race for every participant
cypher: MATCH (n:study)-[]-(p:participant) RETURN p.sex AS Participant_Sex,  p.race AS Participant_Race,  COUNT(p) AS Participant_Count

question: summary of participants by gender and race for each study
cypher: MATCH (n:study)-[]-(p:participant) RETURN n.study_short_name AS Study_Name,  p.sex AS Participant_Sex,  p.race AS Participant_Race,  COUNT(p) AS Participant_Count

question: how many african males in the PLCO study
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study {study_short_name: 'PLCO'}) WHERE tolower(p.sex) = 'male' AND (tolower(p.race) contains 'african') RETURN s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.sex as Participant_Sex, p.race as Participant_Race, count(p) AS total_african_male_participants

question: for each study, count of participants by race
cypher: match (s:study) - []-(p:participant) return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.race, count(p) as Participant_Race_Count

question: for each study, count of participants by gender and race
cypher: match (s:study) - []-(p:participant) return s.study_name, s.study_short_name, p.sex, p.race, count(p) as Participant_Race_Count

question: how many participants have kidney or prostate cancer that are male
cypher: MATCH (p:participant)-[]-(s:study) WHERE tolower(p.sex) = 'male' AND   (tolower(p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site) contains('kidney') or        tolower(p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site) contains('prostate')) RETURN p.sex as Participant_Sex,  p.cancer_diagnosis_primary_site as Participant_Cancer_Site,  count(p) AS total_participants_with_kidney_or_prostate_cancer

question: how many white participants in all studies
cypher: match(p:participant) where p.race contains("white") return p.race as Participant_Race, count(p) as Participant_Count

question: how many bi_racial participants in all studies
cypher: match(p:participant)-[]-(s:study) where p.number_of_races = 2 return p.race as Participant_Race, count(p) as Number_of_Participants
